summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for Innoanswers:
1. Redesigning and streamlining the footer into 4 distinct columns (Brand & CTA, Explore Pages, Company, and Direct Contact Information) while removing the selected byline and chips to optimize spacing.
2. Building Phenom-inspired pinned cinematic scroll storytelling components with dynamic image transitions and synchronized narrative steps.
3. Enhancing the dedicated pages (About, Services, Blogs, and Contact) to match the visual identity, cinematic imagery, and responsive typography of the homepage.
4. Complete verification and compilation across all viewport sizes.
